title: Sparkly envelope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='env' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5c76a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- envelope body -->
  <rect x='22' y='34' width='56' height='38' rx='5' fill='url(#env)' stroke='#d9a544' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- flap -->
  <path d='M22 40 L50 60 L78 40' fill='none' stroke='#c9902f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flap fill triangle -->
  <path d='M24 36 L50 55 L76 36 Z' fill='#fff4cf'/>
  <!-- seal / heart -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='7' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='7' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M14 18 L14 26 M10 22 L18 22' stroke='#7ff3ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M86 20 L86 30 M81 25 L91 25' stroke='#a8ffb0' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M15 74 L15 82 M11 78 L19 78' stroke='#ffd36b' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M85 70 L85 78 M81 74 L89 74' stroke='#ffa8d8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M50 14 L50 22 M46 18 L54 18' stroke='#c9a8ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M32 84 L32 89 M29.5 86.5 L34.5 86.5' stroke='#7ff3ff' stroke-width='2'/>
    <path d='M70 88 L70 93 M67.5 90.5 L72.5 90.5' stroke='#ffe15e' stroke-width='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
